# Loopwright

> An AI agent built to be watched: every step emits a typed event, the cockpit lights up the architecture as events
> play, and any run can be replayed. Python standard library only. Runs offline on a scripted model or a local open-source model, on a Claude Code
> subscription, or on an Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible API key.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what it is, quickstart, eval numbers
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): one turn through the code
- [Events](docs/events.md): every event kind and the box it lands on
